skill.name: gwas-database
skill.description: Query the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog for SNP-trait associations, variants, traits, studies, and summary statistics.
skill.summary: Guides GWAS Catalog searches for genetic variants, traits, studies, and summary statistics.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill is a documentation and workflow helper for public NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog resources. Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code examples and public API URLs. The remaining confirmed issue is plaintext HTTP or FTP guidance for bulk data downloads, which can affect data integrity.

remediation.issue: Plaintext FTP and HTTP bulk-download guidance
remediation.suggestion: Use HTTPS download URLs where available and recommend checksum or signature verification for downloaded summary statistics.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid hammering the API with rapid consecutive requests
- Variant IDs: `rs` numbers (e.g., rs7903146) or `variant_id` format
- `size` parameter: Number of results per page
- `_links` in response: URLs for next/previous pages
The web interface at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/ supports multiple search modes:

content.value_statement: GWAS research often requires precise variant, trait, and study lookups. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through GWAS Catalog searches and API workflows.
actual_capabilities: Find SNP-trait associations by rs ID, EFO trait, gene symbol, genomic region, or study accession.
Explain GWAS Catalog REST API and summary statistics API endpoints with query parameters.
Guide pagination, p-value filtering, and extraction of association fields from API responses.
Support study metadata review, including PubMed IDs, cohorts, ancestry fields, and sample sizes.
Describe bulk summary statistics access and downstream uses such as fine mapping or colocalization.
limitations: It depends on the public GWAS Catalog and does not include a local database copy.
It does not verify clinical validity or provide medical advice.
Some studies lack full summary statistics or harmonized effect sizes.
Large downloads and intensive analyses require user-managed storage and compute resources.

use_cases.title: Variant Association Review
use_cases.description: Look up all reported traits for a specific rs ID and summarize p-values, alleles, and study links.

use_cases.title: Trait Evidence Collection
use_cases.description: Collect genome-wide significant associations for a disease or phenotype before a literature review.

use_cases.title: API Workflow Design
use_cases.description: Plan reproducible GWAS Catalog API queries with pagination, filters, and clear output fields.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up a Variant
prompt_templates.prompt: Find GWAS Catalog associations for rs7903146. Summarize traits, p-values, reported alleles, and source studies.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Disease Trait
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the GWAS Catalog for type 2 diabetes associations. Use the relevant EFO trait and list key variants and studies.

prompt_templates.title: Design an API Query Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GWAS Catalog API plan for EFO_0001360 with pagination, p-value filtering, fields to extract, and rate limiting.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Catalog and Summary Statistics
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare curated associations and summary statistics for a trait. Explain when to use each API and how to validate results.

output_examples.output: A concise association summary with traits, p-values, risk alleles, study accessions, and links for deeper review.

output_examples.input: Plan a type 2 diabetes GWAS Catalog query.
output: Identify the EFO trait and relevant endpoints.
Query associations with pagination and significance filters.
Extract variants, effect sizes, alleles, ancestry fields, and publication metadata.

output_examples.input: Explain how to download summary statistics for one study.
output_examples.output: A safe download plan that checks study availability, chooses harmonized files when present, and records source and access date.

best_practices: Start with EFO terms or study accessions before building automated queries.
Record query dates, endpoint URLs, p-value thresholds, and filtering choices for reproducibility.
Cache public API responses and use delays to avoid excessive requests.
anti_patterns: Do not treat GWAS associations as clinical recommendations without expert review.
Do not combine studies without checking ancestry, sample overlap, and effect-size harmonization.
Do not run large downloads without confirming storage, checksums, and data-use requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No. The GWAS Catalog APIs are public and do not require authentication.

faq.question: Can it search by rs ID?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains variant endpoints and workflows for rs ID association lookups.

faq.question: Can it search diseases or traits?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports trait searches using EFO terms and GWAS Catalog association endpoints.

faq.question: Does it include full summary statistics?
faq.answer: It guides access to public summary statistics when available, but it does not bundle datasets.

faq.question: Is this medical advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports research workflows and should not be used for diagnosis or treatment decisions.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it for scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides API patterns that Claude Code and Codex can adapt into reproducible scripts.
